subject: Scheduling: Citrine Systems POC kickoff — rotating hands-on windows (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@citrine-systems.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.m@citrine-systems.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff + multi-region coordination

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. Citrine is ready to move to a hands-on POC. We have a small cross-functional team that needs to participate: product (me), platform (Asha), and ops (ops@citrine-systems.com). Our goals for the kickoff are: prompt review (we have a set of 12 representative prompts), routing/priority rules (we use region-based routing and a few custom fallbacks), and a short load rehearsal (20–30 minute spike at ~50 TPS equivalent).

Because our team is distributed (San Francisco, Berlin, Bengaluru), we'd prefer rotating windows so people can join at least one session during normal hours. I attached the POC requirements doc with the prompt set and rough SLAs. Can you propose a cadence (3 sessions over two weeks) and who from Redwood will be on each call?

Thanks —
Samir Patel
Senior Product Manager, Citrine Systems
Samir.Patel@citrine-systems.com
Attachment: Citrine_POC_requirements.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@citrine-systems.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + multi-region coordination

Samir —

Appreciate the detail and the prompt set. Attachments look good. Proposed plan (short summary):
- Three hands-on sessions: one focused on prompts & quality review, one on routing/fallbacks, one for a targeted load rehearsal.
- Rotating windows so each session hits a comfortable local time for one region (US morning / EU late afternoon / APAC evening).
- Redwood attendees: me (POC lead), Ben (inference/runtime), Jonas (routing & infra). We’ll also bring a dedicated engineer for the load spike if needed.

I attached a quick rotation grid (proposed-rotation-grid.csv) with sample slot times in UTC and localized equivalents — please glance and flag any hard constraints. Two quick asks before we lock slots:
1) Confirm which prompts you want run in the load rehearsal (we can run a 20-minute synthetic replay).
2) Are there any network egress/VPN requirements for your on-prem agents during the load test?

If that works, I’ll send calendar invites with explicit localized times and a short agenda per slot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Ben/Jonas —

Looping you both to align on who will own which rotating window for Citrine's POC. Samir asked for 3 sessions spread over two weeks (prompt review, routing, load spike). Proposed split:
- US-friendly window (UTC-7 morning): Marissa + Ben (runtime tuning, KV/cache parameters)
- EU-friendly window (UTC+1 late afternoon): Jonas (routing, fallback policies)
- APAC-friendly window (UTC+5:30 evening): Ben (or Evelyn if Ben needs a daytime handoff)

Other notes:
- We should prepare a 10-min pre-setup checklist for Citrine (tokenization, prompt scaffolding, model variant selection).
- Ben — can you confirm whether you’ll need a dedicated GPU reservation for the load spike? If so, estimate hours.

I’ll draft the calendar invites after you confirm.

—Marissa

- I’ll cover the US window and own the load spike. I expect we’ll need a 2-hour dedicated slot (one for ramp + one for sustained replay) — estimate 4 GPU-hours on a mid-tier instance.
- Jonas, please take the EU window. Evelyn — can you be on-call for the APAC window? If you can’t, I’ll flip to cover APAC but prefer to avoid a late-night shift.

Samir / Asha —

Thanks for the quick confirmation earlier. Finalized plan and invites below. I’ve also attached the rotation grid and the short agenda for each session. High-level:

Sessions (each ~75 minutes):
- Session A (Prompts & quality review) — US-friendly: 2027-07-08 09:00 PDT / 12:00 EDT
  * Goal: run 6 representative prompts live, adjust system prompts and temperature.
  * Redwood: Marissa + Ben

- Session B (Routing & fallbacks) — EU-friendly: 2027-07-13 17:30 CEST
  * Goal: validate region routing, prioritize tenants, test fallback flows.
  * Redwood: Jonas + Marissa (overlap)

- Session C (Load rehearsal) — APAC-friendly: 2027-07-15 19:30 IST
  * Goal: 20-minute synthetic replay at target QPS, observe latency and token cost.
  * Redwood: Ben + Evelyn (monitoring + autoscale watch)

Action items for Citrine:
- Please confirm which prompts (from the attached Citrine_POC_requirements.pdf) you want in the load rehearsal by 2027-07-06.
- Confirm whether any of your agents require a private egress/VPN ACL to reach our test endpoints.

Calendar invites: https://redwood.ai/scheduler/rd-2027-217 (each invite has localized times and a Meet link).
Pre-reads & artifacts: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-plans
